$comment: Authentication flows owned by this repo. apply.mjs rebuilds a flow when its executions (or an execution's config) differ from this list (top-level flows are recreated under a temporary alias and swapped, so the realm never points at a half-built flow).

flows.description: CivicOS email-first sign-in: identify, apply the organisation's policy, password, email code or SSO, second factor, 30-day mailbox check, assurance level.
First council SSO sign-in: guard the domain, then create the account or link it to the existing one with the same verified email.
Every council SSO sign-in: record the method, organisation membership and assurance level 2.

CivicOS forgotten password: email and sign-in routing (no reset for SSO-required organisations, personal or unknown domains), emailed link, new password, then back to the sign-in page (no sign-in from a reset, no authenticator removal).
Bound as the realm's direct grant flow: password grants never give tokens in realm ocn, whatever a client's settings.
